breaking.change: A progress bar's indicator takes the pack's new `Progress.fill` slot instead of a fixed accent capsule; the look packs draw it with their track and range parts.
breaking.fix: A pack that dressed `Bar.fill` for a progress bar's colour sets `Progress.fill`.

breaking.change: The packs' `fg`, `fg-muted` and `fg-subtle` are light and dark pairs, and their drawn frames fix their own scheme (`scheme-light` on the light parts, `scheme-dark` on the dark ones), so words over key art in a screen's dark scheme read light and words on a part read in the part's ink.
breaking.fix: Text a game sets on one of these packs' parts reads `text-fg`; text over the picture outside a part reads in the screen's scheme.

added.summary: Pack slots for a full-screen built-in's shade over the picture, its heading, its small words and a title screen's call to start.
